name: hyperbricks
description: Build, author, troubleshoot, and package HyperBricks applications with bundled workflow and developer handbooks.

interface.shortDescription: Build HyperBricks applications with native workflows.
interface.longDescription: A HyperBricks authoring skill with bundled developer and skills handbooks. Covers modules, YAML components, templates, HTMX fragments, Spaces and Markdown, server integrations, native Go plugins, and delivery workflows. Selects documentation to match the runtime and preserves source ownership.
defaultPrompt: Create a HyperBricks module with a page and HTMX fragment.
Add editable Spaces and Markdown to my HyperBricks site.
Diagnose and fix a HyperBricks rendering problem.
